skill.name: color-palette-generator
skill.description: Generate accessible color palettes with WCAG compliance

generated_query: I'm building the visual design system for an internal analytics dashboard, and I need to ensure all color combinations meet accessibility standards from the start. I have three brand hex colors: `#0d6efd` (primary blue), `#198754` (success green), and `#dc3545` (danger red). I want to generate a triadic color scheme based on the primary blue, then expand it into a full accessible palette that passes WCAG 2.1 AA at minimum. Please also create dark mode variants for each color and export the final palette as CSS custom properties and a JSON token file. I'll need a contrast matrix showing ratios between all foreground/background pairs, plus a short accessibility report flagging any combinations that fail AA. Output the results in a clear, well-structured way so I can drop the tokens straight into my design system.
